text:
I can't confirm any award *Avatar: The Last Airbender* won in 2006. The closest verifiable wins are from the 34th Annie Awards (held 2007, for 2006 work): Best Character Animation in a Television Production for "The Blind Bandit" and Best Directing in an Animated Television Production for "The Drill", per [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:_The_Last_Airbender_season_2). The team note's options (Emmy for Outstanding Voice-Over Performance, or Kids' Choice Favorite Cartoon) don't appear in anything I found, and the Emmy I did find was a 2007 Outstanding Individual Achievement in Animation for "Lake Logai".

CONFIDENCE: 25
